reason: The bug was in customers.lookup@1 (src/handlers/customers.lookup.mjs). It read from the legacy CRM nightly export (src/legacy/crm.mjs), which is regenerated once a day. Customers registered since the last export were therefore missing and returned NOT_FOUND. customers.register@1 writes to the application's customer store (src/store.mjs), which is the system of record for urn:example:customers:customer and is seeded from the same export at start-up. The fix changes lookup to read from that store through getCustomer and return the same five contract fields. Unknown IDs still fail with NOT_FOUND. Only the lookup module changed, and no contract was changed. Verification passed all checks. The contract is unchanged and outputs match the contract. Lookup still fails only with NOT_FOUND. Answers on existing state are unchanged for customers.lookup@1 and billing.contact@1. customers.register@1's declared verification passed, including the customer-readable state check through customers.lookup@1.

checks.rule: only the target's implementation module changes
the application loads and answers appport.manifest@1
the published contract is unchanged (contractDigest sha256:4f6660b5135b)
the published contract has no validation errors
every output observed conforms to its declared output schema
customers.lookup@1 fails only with its declared failure codes (NOT_FOUND)
answers on existing state are unchanged for customers.lookup@1, billing.contact@1
customers.register@1: declared verification (customer-readable, registered-event) is not contradicted and every state method confirms
